result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-round payment processor**\. However, if you're running your store on Shopify, Shopify Payments is often the better choice because it's built directly into the platform.

The best option depends on your ecommerce platform, monthly sales and whether you sell mainly in the UK or internationally.

## Best payment processors for a small online store

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Around 1.5% + 20p for standard UK cards.
- No standard monthly processing fee.
- Excellent integrations with WooCommerce and custom websites.
- Supports subscriptions, international payments and fraud prevention.
  
  Best for independent online stores.   [Stripe website](https://stripe.com/gb)

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify)

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- Simplifies checkout, refunds and reporting.
- Avoids additional third-party transaction fees imposed by Shopify.
  
  Best if your store already runs on Shopify. [www.businessexpert.co.uk](https://www.businessexpert.co.uk/payment-processing/stripe-vs-shopify-payments/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
  
  [Shopify Payments website](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

---

**3\. Square**

- Straightforward setup.
- Online and in-person payment processing.
- Useful inventory and business management tools.
  
  Best if you also sell at markets, events or a physical shop. **4\. PayPal**

- Familiar and trusted by many online shoppers.
- Lets customers pay using their PayPal accounts.
- Useful as an additional checkout option.
  
  Best as a supplementary payment method rather than your only processor. [www.businessexpert.co.uk](https://www.businessexpert.co.uk/payment-processing/stripe-vs-paypal/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
  
  [PayPal Business website](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

## My recommendation

For a typical small UK ecommerce business, I'd start with\:

- **Stripe** for debit and credit card payments.
- **PayPal** as an additional checkout option.
- **Apple Pay and Google Pay** where supported.

This gives customers flexibility without making your payment setup unnecessarily complicated.
